title: Block 6: Implement the Explicit Halt-and-Heal Fallback Mechanism for
description: Implement the Explicit Halt-and-Heal Fallback Mechanism for Synthesizer rejections. [Acceptance Criteria: If the Synthesizer rejects a component, the execution engine forces a 3-line spatial break, prints the explicit rejection reason in bright Red, and re-queues the specific failing MICRO node for a new specialized worker attempt without any silent retries.]
